Enhanced Candidate Matching
We've significantly improved our candidate scoring feature based on feedback from beta testers and early adopters. Here's what's new:
Refined scoring algorithms for more accurate ratings
User-customizable scoring parameters for fine-tuning results
Comprehensive candidate analysis, considering soft skills and personality traits
Detailed score explanations, providing insights into each candidate's strengths and weaknesses
Ability to mark signals as "Required," allowing our AI to flag candidates who don't meet specified criteria
